definitions.ask: Should the automatic rerun also watch the CI workflow, not just Release-plz?
definitions.why: CI's macos-latest leg has the same exposure, and the detector is identical

choices.label: Watch Release-plz and CI, so a starved macos-latest CI leg on master or a release PR is rerun too
Watch Release-plz only, so a starved CI leg stays red until someone reruns it by hand

definitions.ask: Should a run get a second automatic rerun when the first rerun is also starved?
definitions.why: matches release_plz_merge.py's rerun-once rule and keeps the PAT out of a workflow_run job

choices.label: Rerun attempts 1 and 2; needs SASE_RELEASE_TOKEN so a rerun can re-trigger the retry workflow
Rerun attempt 1 only, with least-privilege GITHUB_TOKEN; the scheduled heal stays the backstop
